description: This file contains utility functions for generating documentation links and rendering related content for Playwright's documentation system, including creating markdown links for classes, members, and handling language-specific formatting.

methods.name: createMarkdownLink
methods.description: Generates a markdown link to a class member documentation page, constructing the URL based on member details and optional parameters.

methods.name: createClassMarkdownLink
methods.description: Creates a markdown link to a class documentation page.

methods.name: docsLinkRendererForLanguage
methods.description: Returns a renderer function that generates markdown links for class members based on language and output type.

methods.name: languageToRelativeDocsPath
methods.description: Maps programming language identifiers to relative documentation path segments.

methods.name: formatClassName
methods.description: Formats class names for assertions based on the target programming language.

methods.name: assertionArgument
methods.description: Returns the argument name associated with a specific assertion class.

methods.name: renderJSSignature
methods.description: Creates a string representing the JavaScript function signature with optional parameters.

methods.name: renderPlaywrightDevLinks
methods.description: Replaces markdown links in content to point to the correct URLs, handling raw image links in release notes mode.
